'''May 2000 Wheaton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in JC Comics, Wheaton, Illinois on 28 May 2000. [[Aaron Gotway]] won it. It is known from Paul Motz's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d821">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-29-wheaton-illinois-5-28-2000d821/ wheaton-illinois-5-28-2000], DeckTech (Paul "Vollerian" Motz, 29 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-29-wheaton-illinois-5-28-2000d821/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 May 2000
* '''Site:''' JC Comics, Wheaton, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Aaron Gotway]]
